schema.description: A price reduction rule that can be applied to subscriptions, targeting specific fee types by a flat amount or a percentage.

allOf.description: Segment scope of the resource. Assigned by ProAbono from the segment reference and returned in responses.
allOf.title: SegmentScopeAttribute

allOf.description: Creation trace of the resource. Set by ProAbono when the record is created, and read-only afterwards.

IdUserCreation.description: ID of the user who created the record.

allOf.title: TraceCreationScopeAttribute

allOf.description: Update trace of the resource. Set by ProAbono on every change.

IdUserUpdate.description: ID of the user who last updated the record.

allOf.title: TraceUpdateScopeAttribute

StateDiscount.description:
State of a discount.

* `Draft` — not yet active
* `Enabled` — active and applicable
StateDiscount.title: StateDiscount

TargetFee.description:
Which fee type a discount applies to.

* `FlatFee` — applied to the flat recurring fee
* `FeatureFee` — applied to feature charges
* `UpfrontFee` — applied to the upfront/setup fee
* `AllRecurring` — applied to all recurring charges
* `All` — applied to all fees
TargetFee.title: TargetFee

ValueOff.description: Discount value — in cents when `TypeOff` is `Flat`, in basis points when `TypeOff` is `PerTenThousand`, where `1000` means 10%.

TypeOff.description:
How the discount value is expressed.

* `Flat` — fixed amount reduction, in cents
* `PerTenThousand` — percentage in basis points, for example `1000` for 10%
TypeOff.title: TypeOff

CountPeriods.description: Number of billing periods the discount applies to. Absent means unlimited.

schema.title: Discount
